Problem Statement
Read N integers into an array and print the sum of all the elements.
Description
Read an integer N, then read N integers into a one-dimensional array using a loop. Use another loop to add up all the elements of the array into a running sum, and print the final sum.
Input Description
An integer N, followed by N integers separated by spaces.
Output Description
Print the sum of the N array elements.
Sample Input
4 3 7 2 8
